units.source_text: 这老侍女是个直率之人，开口就嚷道：“啊呀，罪过罪过啊！

en.t: This old gentlewoman was a blunt, straightforward person, and the moment she opened her mouth she cried, "Oh my, what a terrible offense!

units.source_text: 叫他坐在这里，太怠慢了，应该请到帘内来坐。

en.t: To have him sit out here is far too discourteous; he ought to be invited inside the curtains to sit.

units.source_text: 你们这些年轻人真是不识轻重的啊！”

en.t: You young people truly have no sense of what matters and what does not!"

units.source_text: 她用老年人的嘶嗄声毫不客气地埋怨，两女公子都觉得难堪。

en.t: She complained without the least restraint in the hoarse voice of old age, and both young ladies felt embarrassed.

units.source_text: 但闻她对薰君说道：“真难得啊！

en.t: Then she was heard saying to Lord Kaoru, "How rare and gracious this is!

units.source_text: 我家亲王离群索居，门庭冷落，连应该来访的人，也都不肯赏光，日渐疏远了。

en.t: Our prince lives withdrawn from the world, and the household has grown lonely; even those who ought to visit will not honor us with their presence, and each day they drift farther away.

units.source_text: 难得您这位中将大人一片诚心，殷勤慰问，连我们这些微不足道之人，也都感激不尽。

en.t: It is a rare kindness that you, my lord Middle Captain, come with such sincere concern and attentive sympathy; even insignificant people like us are deeply grateful.

units.source_text: 小姐们亦深感盛情，年轻人怕羞，难于启齿。”

en.t: The young ladies also feel your generosity deeply, but young people are shy and find it hard to speak."

units.source_text: 她毫无顾虑，信口直言，令人难于入耳。

en.t: She spoke straight out without any hesitation, saying whatever came to mind, and it was hard to listen to.

units.source_text: 但这老侍女人品相当高尚，言语也落落大方。

en.t: Yet this old gentlewoman was of quite noble character, and her words had an open, dignified ease.

units.source_text: 于是薰君答道：“我正狼狈不知所措，听了你的话不胜喜慰。

en.t: Lord Kaoru then replied, "I was just flustered and at a loss, so hearing your words has brought me the greatest comfort and delight.

units.source_text: 有你这深通情理的人在此，今后我便放心了。”

en.t: With someone here who understands feeling and propriety as deeply as you do, I can be at ease from now on."

units.source_text: 侍女们从帷屏旁边窥看，但见他靠在廊柱上，曙光渐渐明亮，照见他身穿日常便服，露水沾湿襟袖。

en.t: The gentlewomen peered from beside the screen and saw him leaning against a veranda pillar; as the dawn gradually brightened, it revealed him in ordinary informal robes, with dew wetting his collar and sleeves.

units.source_text: 一种世间所无的异香四散飘溢，令人不胜惊讶。

en.t: A strange fragrance unlike anything in the world drifted and spread in every direction, astonishing them beyond measure.

units.source_text: 老侍女哭着对他说道：“我深恐多嘴获罪，因此隐忍不说。

en.t: The old gentlewoman said to him through her tears, "I have long feared that speaking too much would bring blame upon me, and so I have held back in silence.

units.source_text: 但有令人感慨的旧事，常思觅一适当机会，如实奉告，使您略知端倪。

en.t: But there is an old matter that moves me deeply, and I have always wished to find a proper chance to tell you the truth, so that you might know at least the beginning of it.

units.source_text: 我年来诵经念佛之时，一向以此事为祈愿之一。

en.t: For years, whenever I recited sutras and called on the Buddha, I made this matter one of my prayers.

units.source_text: 想是因此获得佛力佑护，使我今日逢此良机，实甚欣幸。

en.t: Perhaps because of that, I have received the Buddha's protection and have met with this good opportunity today, which makes me truly glad.

units.source_text: 然而尚未开言，眼泪已经涌塞双目，话也说不出了。”

en.t: Yet before I can even begin, tears have already filled my eyes, and I can no longer speak."

units.source_text: 她浑身颤抖，实在非常悲伤。

en.t: Her whole body trembled, and she was truly overcome with grief.

units.source_text: 薰君见闻所及，老年人大都容易流泪。

en.t: From what Lord Kaoru had seen and heard, old people were generally quick to tears.

units.source_text: 但这老妪何故如此悲伤，使他不胜诧异。

en.t: But he was deeply puzzled as to why this old woman should be so grief-stricken.

units.source_text: 便对她说：“我来此访问，至今已有多次。

en.t: So he said to her, "I have come here to visit many times already.

units.source_text: 只因没有像你那样知情达理的人，每次总是走着多露的山路，沾湿了衣裳独自归去。

en.t: Only because there was no one as understanding and sensible as you, each time I walked back alone along the dew-laden mountain path, my clothes soaked through.

units.source_text: 今日逢到了你，我真高兴！

en.t: I am truly happy to have met you today!

units.source_text: 请你把话尽情告诉我吧。”

en.t: Please tell me everything that is on your mind."

units.source_text: 老侍女说：“此种良机，恐怕不易再得。

en.t: The old gentlewoman said, "Such a fine opportunity will probably not be easy to have again.

units.source_text: 即使再有，我命今夜不知明日，不能保证再得会见。

en.t: Even if another should come, at my age I do not know tonight whether I shall see tomorrow, and I cannot be sure we will meet again.

units.source_text: 今日共话，只是使您知道世间尚有我这个老妪而已。

en.t: Our conversation today is only to let you know that an old woman like me still exists in this world.

units.source_text: 我听人说，在三条宫邸服侍令堂三公主的侍女小侍从已经亡故了。

en.t: I have heard that Ko Jijū, the gentlewoman who served your mother, the Third Princess, at the Sanjō residence, has already passed away.

units.source_text: 当年与我亲睦往来的人，有许多已经去世。

en.t: Many of the people who were close to me and visited with me in those days have already died.

units.source_text: 我到了老年，才从遥远的他乡回京，在这里供职已有五六年了。

en.t: Only in old age did I return to the capital from a distant province, and I have served here for five or six years now.

units.source_text: 您大概不知道吧：关于当时称为红梅大纳言的兄长柏木卫门督的逝世，世人在谈话中有一种传说，不知您听到过没有？

en.t: You probably do not know this, but concerning the death of Kashiwagi, the Emon no Kami, elder brother of the man then called the Kobai Dainagon, there is a certain rumor people tell; I wonder whether you have heard it.

units.source_text: 回想柏木卫门督逝世，似觉相隔年月不远。

en.t: When I think back on Kashiwagi, the Emon no Kami, passing away, it seems as though not many years have gone by.

units.source_text: 那时悲伤痛哭，衣袖上的眼泪还不曾干呢。

en.t: At that time I wept bitterly with grief, and it feels as though the tears on my sleeves have still not dried.

units.source_text: 但屈指计算，光阴真快，您已经如此长大成人了，真像做梦一般。

en.t: Yet when I count the years on my fingers, time has passed so quickly, and to see you grown so fully into adulthood feels just like a dream.

units.source_text: 这位已故的权大纳言的乳母，是我弁君的母亲。

en.t: The nurse of that late Provisional Major Counselor was the mother of me, Ben no Kimi.

units.source_text: 因此我得朝夕侍奉权大纳言，甚是熟悉。

en.t: For that reason I was able to serve the Provisional Major Counselor morning and evening, and I knew him very well.

units.source_text: 我身虽甚微贱，但权大纳言有时常把不可告人而自心难于隐忍的话向我诉说。

en.t: Though my own station was very low, the Provisional Major Counselor would sometimes confide in me things he could tell no one else and could scarcely keep hidden in his own heart.

units.source_text: 后来病势危笃，弥留之际，又曾召我到病床前，嘱咐我几句遗言。

en.t: Later, when his illness grew grave and he lay at the point of death, he summoned me again to his bedside and entrusted me with a few final words.

units.source_text: 其中确有应该教您知道的话。

en.t: Among them there are indeed words that you ought to know.

units.source_text: 但我也只能说到这里。

en.t: But for now I can say only this much.

units.source_text: 您倘欲知其余详情，且待将来徐徐奉告。

en.t: If you wish to know the remaining details, please wait until I can tell them to you gradually in the future.

units.source_text: 这班年轻人都在交头接耳，埋怨我多嘴饶舌，这也是难怪的。”

en.t: These young people are all whispering to one another and blaming me for chattering too much, and that is no wonder."

units.source_text: 她果然不再说下去了。

en.t: As she had said, she went no further.
